what: Three entries of the errata shipped in the judged snapshot state the opposite of what GNU ed 1.19 does, which is why the panel read the reference as wrong.

claims.said: An apostrophe address whose mark was never set does not fail. It resolves to address 0.
claims.observed: 'a= prints 0 only while the buffer is empty; with one line it prints ?

claims.said: A mark stays on its line when that line is changed, and it survives the undo of that change.
claims.observed: after 1ka and 1s/a/A/, 'a= prints ?; after u it prints 1

claims.said: A global command list whose first line holds nothing but a backslash is an empty command list, which means p for every selected line.
claims.observed: the backslash continues the list, so g/./ with a backslash then an empty line prints every selected line twice, and a following q joins the list
